_README: Per-tier bits-per-pixel floors. A tier ABSENT here is NOT enforced (check() returns 'ok') - deliberate: an uncalibrated guess rejects good downloads. Derived 2026-08-25 from a library verified 1294/1294 intact by full demux sweep.
_METHOD: reject is set BELOW the minimum of the verified-clean corpus, not at a percentile. A percentile floor rejects your own good files by construction (0.80 x p05 rejected 5 Adventure Time episodes on a library confirmed intact - flat animation compresses better than anything else here). The floor answers 'thinner than ANY good file I own', which is a real signal; 'below the 5th percentile of my own library' is not.

hd1080._note: reject = 0.80 Mbps at 1920x1080. Rejects 0 files in the clean library. 1116 samples, many shows and codecs, relative-outliers excluded.

_sd_DELIBERATELY_UNSET.why_not: 156 sd files but 153 are Dragon Ball, an unusually generous release at 0.42 bpp. Calibrating from it demands 2.43 Mbps at 708x480 and would reject good SD (typically 1-1.5 Mbps) including this library's own Adventure Time at 0.066-0.10. n=156 is one SHOW, not one sample set.
_sd_DELIBERATELY_UNSET.meanwhile: relative_outliers catches thin SD within a season and needs no calibration.
